Cashier Stivvo is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City.
“
I saw nothing! Hells, I'd rob this place too!
„
— Stivvo

Involvement

Stivvo tells the party to go see  Head Clerk Meadhoney about a vault pass. Before her  Brid Hunley and  Skonal Dehann are waiting in line to be serviced.
